# Vendored glslang 16.6.0

Windows x86-64 release compiler, copied without modification from `bin/glslang.exe`.
This is the current name of the glslangValidator command-line tool.

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang/releases/tag/16.6.0

Asset: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang/releases/download/16.6.0/glslang-16.6.0-windows-x86_64-release.zip

Asset SHA-256: `82bf434e69b9bb4829de7e2b4bc2c5e7a7861e53d66cf75e5cc70f5f694a8d9b`

Executable SHA-256 is pinned in SHA256.txt and checked before execution.
Build and release workflows use only this executable; no compiler download or PATH fallback.
See LICENSE.txt for upstream notices. This build tool is not distributed in the mod artifact.
